entries.en: I think we might be good to go[n]back to Taihei now.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I think we've already learned all that we[n]possibly could. Let's go see Taihei.

entries.speaker: Female Student Who Likes Sweets
entries.en: Is Ms. Kawakami's name actually "Becky"?[n]Hahaha, no, no, that's not it at all.

entries.speaker: Female Student Who Likes Sweets
entries.en: Ms. Kawakami used to work at a pastry[n]shop called "Becky" back when she was[n]a student though.

entries.speaker: Female Student Who Likes Sweets
entries.en: Huh. I wonder if that place is still around.[n]I think I'll try looking for it sometime...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I see. So Kawakami took the name she[n]uses in her work as a maid from there.

entries.speaker: Female Student Who Likes Sweets
entries.en: I should go eat at that pastry shop,[n]"Becky," sometime...

entries.speaker: Female Student Who Likes Sweets
entries.en: What the heck was up with that boy[n]from Class D, the one who used to be[n]on the volleyball team?

entries.speaker: Female Student Who Likes Sweets
entries.en: Hey... I don't feel like talking right now.[n]Would you mind leaving me alone?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She better not be talking about Mishima...
